sources.title: 最高人民法院 司法部 中华全国律师协会印发《部分案件起诉状答辩状示范文本》
sources.issuing_authority: 最高人民法院 (Supreme People's Court of the PRC), with 司法部 and 中华全国律师协会
sources.verification_evidence: Page retrieved and read in full on 2026-10-10. It states that the three bodies jointly issued 《部分案件起诉状答辩状示范文本》 covering 9 domains / 67 categories (56 new on top of the first batch of 11 issued 2024-03-04), effective nationwide from 2025-07-14 under a '积极引导、尊重选择' principle. The page links one attachment PDF (see spc-2025-notice-pdf). It does NOT itself host individual per-category template files.
sources.notes: Announcement-level evidence only. Verifying this page does NOT verify any individual template.

sources.title: 最高人民法院就全面推广应用起诉状答辩状示范文本工作答记者问 — 67类示范文本全面推广使用诉讼便利再提升
sources.issuing_authority: 最高人民法院 (Supreme People's Court of the PRC)
sources.verification_evidence: Page retrieved and read in full on 2026-10-10. It confirms the 2025-07-14 nationwide rollout, the first batch of 11 civil categories trialled from 2024-03 (72% voluntary uptake reported), the 56 newly added categories, and that the second batch adds 填写实例、填写说明、证据清单、纠纷解决方式意愿栏 and supports online filling via 人民法院在线服务.
sources.notes: Explanatory material. It mentions 证据清单 as a content element of the demonstration texts; it does not define a standalone evidence-list document, and it does not mention any 送达地址确认书.

sources.title: 《最高人民法院 司法部 中华全国律师协会关于印发部分案件起诉状答辩状示范文本的通知》及所附示范文本
sources.issuing_authority: 最高人民法院, 司法部, 中华全国律师协会
sources.verification_evidence: Downloaded once on 2026-10-10 for inspection only (stored in a temporary directory outside the repository). Verified: PDF 1.7 magic bytes, 6832359 bytes, 975 pages, 23 embedded font files, 55 ToUnicode maps. Text extraction located a table of contents and per-category 民事起诉状/民事答辩状 sections. Located 民事起诉状 pages for every application category: 离婚纠纷 p57, 买卖合同纠纷 p71, 民间借贷纠纷 p134, 物业服务合同纠纷 p233, 劳动争议纠纷 p248. SHA-256 recorded below.
sources.notes: URL path implies the file was uploaded on 2025-06-22 and it is referenced by the 2025-06-23 news page; the document's own date line was not extracted, so both date fields are null. Content was inspected structurally and partially by text extraction; a full page-by-page legal review was NOT performed. The file is a 6.8 MB third-party document and must not be committed to the repository without a rights review.
